column1: # TITLE: Identification of a Four-lncRNA Signature Predicting Prognosis of Patients with NSCLC

# SUMMARY: LncRNA expression profiles were sucessfully contructed in 370 patients with NSCLC and 198 corresponding adjacent noncancerous tissues using a custom microarray containing probes for 2412 lncRNAs and an outcome prediction of lncRNA signature was successfully identified for predicting prognosis in NSCLC.
